detail.title: Intex 16 Channel DVR
detail.overview: Secure your home, office, shop, warehouse, or commercial space with the Intex 16 Channel DVR, designed to deliver reliable and uninterrupted surveillance. Featuring advanced H.264/H.265 video compression, it optimizes storage while maintaining high-quality recordings. With support for 24x7 continuous recording, P2P remote access, and dual SATA hard drive compatibility, this DVR ensures your security system is always connected and protected. Monitor your cameras anytime, anywhere through the mobile app, and enjoy seamless connectivity with HDMI and VGA outputs for crystal-clear video playback. Built for performance and reliability, the Intex DVR is the ideal choice for comprehensive surveillance solutions.
features: 16 Channel DVR for connecting multiple CCTV cameras.
H.264/H.265 video compression for efficient storage and smoother playback.
P2P remote viewing to monitor your property anytime, anywhere.
Mobile app support for live view and playback on smartphones.
Dual SATA support for expanded storage capacity.
HDMI & VGA outputs for high-definition display compatibility.
Video & audio control for complete surveillance management.
Reliable performance for homes, offices, retail stores, warehouses, and commercial establishments.
